title: Invariant Gibbs dynamics for the hyperbolic sinh-Gordon model
summary: We study the hyperbolic defocusing sinh-Gordon model with parameter $β^2>0$ and its associated Gibbs dynamics on the two-dimensional torus. We establish global well-posedness of the model for a certain range of parameters $β^2>0$ with the corresponding Gibbs measure initial data and prove invariance of the Gibbs measure under the flow, thereby resolving a question posed by Oh, Robert, and Wang (2019).
